name: Her Name Is Olgra
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
narrative.objectives: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
narrative.offerRewardText: I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!You have done me... done us... a great favor, Johnathon.
narrative.requestItemsText: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
